source_attribution: Shimshon Amitsur / Alexander Levitzki, 1950 (catalog metadata; uncited and inconsistent with the inspected A. S. Amitsur / J. Levitzki paper)
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For each positive n and all 2*n square n-by-n matrices over a field, the signed alternating sum over all permutations of their ordered products is zero; possible later coefficient-ring generalization and minimality or uniqueness clauses are not selected.
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only an unspecified matrix-ring polynomial-identity gloss. The inspected 1950 paper contains a standard-identity theorem, minimal-degree result, uniqueness/classification results, characteristic-two exceptions, and general-algebra extensions, but the catalog does not select among them. It also does not fix field versus commutative-ring coefficients, size and positivity binders, the free-polynomial versus evaluated encoding, sign and product conventions, or boundary cases. The catalog coauthor forename Alexander conflicts with the paper and Crossref's J. Levitzki. Choosing a familiar formulation now would invent or substitute material scope.
target_decision: preserve the Amitsur-Levitzki matrix polynomial-identity family while leaving the canonical proposition null until independent source review selects and maps one exact source clause

canonical_formal_target.candidate_boundary: Pinned APIs can encode finite signed sums of ordered products in square matrix rings, but no exact Amitsur-Levitzki declaration was located by the bounded intake search. Encoding vocabulary neither selects nor proves the source target.
